notes.title: The Dreamatorium 2: Released!
notes.content:
The Dreamatorium 2 has been released today, on 9/9/2015 at 9AM, CET, with [b]10% off[/b] to celebrate the premiere. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/393150

[h1]Don't forget that promotion will last one week![/h1]

Cheers!

notes.title: The Dreamatorium 2 on Steam!
notes.content:
The Dreamatorium of Dr. Magnus was [b]first released[/b] on 9/9/2012. 

Now, on the same day three years later, the second chapter of the game you loved comes to Steam!

The Dreamatorium of Dr. Magnus 2 will be available on September 9th, with [b]10% off[/b] to celebrate the premiere. 

[h1]The promotion will last one week.[/h1]
